notes_for_annotators: Target arXiv:2006.11239 (DDPM, Ho, Jain & Abbeel 2020), corpus of 10 real abstracts, all fetched 2026-07-29 from arxiv.org abs pages (provenance in artifacts/res-ddpm/PROVENANCE). ADJUDICATION (E5 answer, verified by reading the abstracts): No corpus item subsumes the target's stated contribution. The target's contribution is a SPECIFIC weighted variational training objective for the diffusion probabilistic model class, justified by a NOVEL connection it draws to denoising score matching with Langevin dynamics, producing new state-of-the-art unconditional image sample quality (FID 3.17 on CIFAR-10). The closest corpus items differ: Sohl-Dickstein et al. (1503.03585, 2015) introduced the GENERAL forward/reverse diffusion probabilistic model framework itself (the target's own foundation, cited as prior art) but neither derives the target's specific simplified weighted variational bound nor demonstrates high-fidelity image synthesis results -- its own abstract frames the contribution as tractability of learning/sampling/inference generally, with no image-quality benchmark results comparable to the target's. Song & Ermon (1907.05600, 2019) independently proposes SCORE-BASED generative modeling via annealed Langevin dynamics with a noise-conditional score network trained by (denoising) score matching across noise levels -- mechanistically adjacent (the target explicitly draws a connection to this line) but a distinct training objective and sampler (no forward/reverse Markov diffusion chain, no variational bound), and its own best reported CIFAR-10 Inception score (8.87) is superseded by, not equivalent to, the target's results. Neither prior work proposes the target's specific combination (diffusion Markov chain + simplified noise-prediction variational objective + explicit score-matching connection) or reports comparable sample-quality numbers. GAN (1406.2661), VAE (1312.6114), RealNVP (1605.08803), and PixelRNN (1601.06759) are different generative-model families entirely (adversarial, single-step latent-variable, normalizing-flow, and autoregressive respectively); BigGAN (1809.11096), Glow (1807.03039) and WaveNet (1609.03499) are background/adjacent results in other mechanisms or modalities. Route minimality: E1 necessary (cannot judge novelty without reading the contribution); E2 necessary (the corpus must actually be searched, not assumed); E3, E4 necessary (the two nearest candidates must be read, not inferred from titles); E5 necessary (the subsumption call is the adjudicated conclusion). Order-coherence by containment. Decoy citation_count_lookup is not a listed action. The answer the ask_user tool returns is this note; E5 attests that the adjudication was obtained.
